answer_2.quote: In this experiment, the evaluation metrics for all measurements are based on exact match, that is, score 1 if exactly the same, otherwise 0.

answer_4.quote: The data annotation was done by three postgraduate/doctoral students of linguistics. Two annotators first label each sample. If there is a disagreement, the third annotator will be involved for discussion and voting.
answer_4.guideline: The annotation mainly follows the OIA graph definition given by but with some confusing or special cases being clarified. In addition, we introduce more detailed type information for the node.
